changelog: FIX: Random app crashes while watching media are resolved — D-pad Close button was unreachable due to off-by-one in control count (8→9), causing focus to loop endlessly and eventually crash.

FIX: Firestick display no longer sleeps after 30 minutes during playback — upgraded to SCREEN_BRIGHT_WAKE_LOCK combined with FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON and FLAG_TURN_SCREEN_ON for bulletproof screen-on during the entire playback session.

FIX: Movies category rail now correctly filters movie titles — Xtream Codes servers return category_id as a float (e.g. 12.0) in VOD streams but as a string (e.g. '12') in category lists; the mismatch is now normalized at parse time so every category maps correctly.
FIX: Firestick D-pad on Movies category rail now uses hover-select — movies update instantly as focus moves (Netflix/Prime style), no OK press required to see results.
FEATURE: 6 new intense neon UI themes — Neon Hot Pink, Neon Lamborghini Orange, Neon Smoke Grey, Neon Smoke White, Neon Charcoal Black, Neon Baby Blue — selectable in Settings → Appearance.
FEATURE: Subtitle outline color is now fully wired — choose from 8 color swatches (Black, Dark Navy, Dark Red, Dark Purple, Dark Green, Charcoal, White, Hot Pink) in Settings → Subtitles.
FEATURE: All subtitle settings (size, text color, outline color, background opacity) are now passed directly to LibVLC's freetype renderer and take effect on the next stream open.
FEATURE: DVR recordings are now organized into per-provider subfolders — files are saved as DVR/<server-hostname>/<filename>.ts, keeping multi-account libraries cleanly separated.
